title: Clean up stale spike entries and add deleted-file pruning
description: Removed spike binaries (hdc-*, hrr-*, fca-spike, salsa-spike, dd-spike) persist as ghost entries in the index, inflating dead code counts (~70 of 103 dead symbols) and distorting health reports.\n\nReparse to clear them. Add a prune step to parse_workspace that checks indexed file existence before the walk-and-parse loop.

acceptance_criteria.text: parse_workspace prunes files that no longer exist on disk
After reparse, sutra_dead no longer reports spike binary symbols
sutra_map no longer lists removed files
